privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.text:
The app does not collect, send or sell any data.
It works without internet: it has no network requests, analytics, ads or third-party services. The Android app does not even have the internet permission.
The model files you open are read only on your device.
Stored on the device: copies of opened files for the Recent list (can be switched off in Settings), layer settings, notes and app settings. This data does not leave the device unless you export your notes or share a file yourself.
To delete everything: clear the Recent list, delete the notes, or remove the app or the site data in the browser.
The app does not ask for the camera, microphone, contacts or location.
tour.welcome.title: A short tour
tour.welcome.text:
One minute to see the main features on a demo model.
Your files stay on the device; no internet is needed.
tour.open.title: Opening files
tour.open.text:
Open picks one or several DXF, GLB, OBJ or STL files. Folder opens everything suitable in a folder at once.
You can also send a file to the app from a file manager or a messenger.
tour.move.title: Moving the view
tour.move.text:
One finger orbits. Two fingers zoom and pan.
Zoom goes towards what is under your fingers and does not pass through it.
Fit brings the whole model back.
tour.cube.title: View cube
tour.cube.text:
Tap a face to look from that side: Top gives the plan, north up.
The arrows turn the view in steps. The red mark shows north.
tour.measure.title: Coordinates and measuring
tour.measure.text:
Tapping a point shows its X, Y, Z, layer and file. The point snaps to the nearest vertex.
A second tap gives distance, height difference, azimuth and dip. Everything can be copied.
tour.notes.title: Notes
tour.notes.text:
The Note button on the point card creates a note with its coordinates, and a numbered flag appears on the model.
The Notes tab also takes general notes and exports all notes as a table.
tour.layers.title: Layers
tour.layers.text:
Each layer has visibility, colour and opacity 100 / 50 / 20 %.
Layers are grouped by file; tap a file name to fold its list. Settings are remembered.
tour.slices.title: Sections
tour.slices.text:
A section leaves only a slab of the model on screen so you can look inside.
The ◀ ▶ arrows page through sections step by step, − and + change the thickness, the eye turns the view to face the section.
A vertical section can run through two points marked on an existing line.
tour.files.title: Recent files and diagnostics
tour.files.text:
Opened files are kept in the Recent list and reopen without internet.
The “i” icon shows a file's diagnostics: what was read, what was skipped and why.
tour.done.title: All set
tour.done.text:
The demo model will now close.
You can run the tour again from Settings (the gear icon).
